description: Retrieve the full content of a plan from the knowledge base by plan ID. Works for plans created via create_extended_plan or via playbook finalization.
embedding_description: Retrieve the full markdown plan document for a known plan_id. Use after a plan has been created, revised, or referenced from another artifact when you need the exact current plan text, numbered steps, sub-steps, and metadata for review, comparison, prompt assembly, debugging, or user-visible explanation.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Full plan markdown content from knowledge base

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Retrieving a plan by ID. get_plan accepts {plan_id}.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: NotFound: plan_id does not exist in thinking_task or thinking_playbook tables.
